summary: Outlook Therapeutics filed an 8-K disclosing a combined registered direct offering and concurrent private placement. On April 22, 2026, the company sold 16,129,033 shares of common stock at $0.31 per share along with warrants to purchase an equal number of shares at the same price. The warrants are exercisable only after stockholder approval and an increase in authorized shares. The offering is priced at-the-market under an effective shelf registration statement. Investors should watch for the stockholder meeting within 90 days and potential dilution if warrants are exercised.
